A handful of files from the official KiCad libraries, unchanged, for the
footprint-verification and library-import tests:

  kicad-footprints/  from https://gitlab.com/kicad/libraries/kicad-footprints
  kicad-symbols/     from https://gitlab.com/kicad/libraries/kicad-symbols

They are by the KiCad library contributors and licensed CC-BY-SA 4.0 with the
KiCad libraries design exception (https://www.kicad.org/libraries/license/).
Forma itself never ships the libraries: it downloads them on demand into a
cache folder on the user's computer.
